access_policy: Exact home source/file exceptions and pinned runtime trees; network and other writes denied; four harmless denied probes per worker

budgets.scope: Count original authoring files once, both exports, all mutation copies, temp/writes/results; external monotonic supervisor includes startup/identity/final writes/exit; stop overrides completion; one consumed envelope; no retries, deletion to hide overruns, tuning or resets

launch_contract.placeholder_rule: Only the two external digest placeholders may be replaced with the SHA256 of the exact release and independent review files; all other argv and environment entries are fixed.
launch_contract.worker_environment_rule: Inherit the fixed coordinator environment plus supervisor run-root/release identity; remove supervisor control descriptors as implemented; reference configure_runtime enforces four intra-op and one inter-op threads.

model_policy.attention: softmax(query @ keys.T / sqrt(64)); four facts plus null

control.fact_values: right cyclic shift by one; destination i gets source (i-1) mod 4
control.name: value_cycle

initialization.random_weights: normal(mean=0, std=0.02), once in listed order

model_policy.name: LearnedFactLevelCompoundBindingV1
model_policy.scope: fixed grammar role extraction with learned binding; not learned English parsing
